description.en: The unique identifier of the workspace. For more information, see [AgentKey](~~2587494~~).

description.zh:
任务唯一ID
> TaskId默认无需填写，系统将自动生成。当后续任务填写的TaskId相同时，表示这些任务属于同一组对话。
>
description.en:
The unique ID of the task.

> This parameter is optional. The system automatically generates a task ID. If subsequent tasks use the same task ID, they are considered part of the same conversation group.

title.zh: 获取内容聚合任务结果
